purpose: Native Phase 0 renderer/asset regression after document/action foundations
limits: Synthetic 1000-ID corpus over 32 hardlinked 6000x4500 JPEG contents; source OS page cache not flushed.
Empty derived cache per trace except each suite cold/warm pair sharing its own SSD cache.
Sequential paired trials, two workers, prefetch/preparation disabled; repeat only pan-normal and pressure.
Product document queries are not integrated into the current GPU benchmark; no product scale claim.
CPU pressure p99 increases in both pairs, correlated with upload CPU stage; cause not established.
